```python
def generate_palindrome(length):
    if length % 2 == 0:
        half_length = length // 2
    else:
        half_length = (length - 1) // 2

    # Generate the first half of the string
    prefix = ''.join(str(i) for i in range(1, half_length + 1))
    
    # Reverse the prefix and add it to the end
    palindrome = prefix + prefix[::-1]
    
    # If the length is odd, remove the last character of the prefix before reversing
    if length % 2 == 0:
        final_palindrome = palindrome
    else:
        final_palindrome = palindrome[:-1]

    return final_palindrome

# Generate a palindrome with at least 335 characters
palindrome_335 = generate_palindrome(335)

```
